title: Builder BLD-301: Surface switcher

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-301.

detail: B3 Lenses, pass BLD-301 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-301). Surface switcher. Scope: components/builder/surfaces. Build: Site, Profile, Spotlight, Email in the top bar; selection persists across switches. Canvas renders at the surface's declared density; sections the surface cannot show are listed with the reason. Done when: Per block and surface, golden markup matches; Hidden-on-surface list equals blocks without that surface. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), check:blocks, pr-compare visual suite, Pass probes, check:surface-binding, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-108. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder spec. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-301.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
